column1: #              projectile. movement (Orbital): orbit radius in world units
#              (0 = sits on the player and follows). onhit: max hits before
#              the projectile despawns (0 = unlimited; caps NoChange/Reflect
#              bounces; sets Multiply split generations; Field ignores it).
#   duration — lifetime only: projectile lifetime in seconds (how long each
#              shot lives). Cooldown weapons use it; a Sustained weapon
#              (firerate 0) ignores it and stays effectively permanent.
#              Ignored (0) elsewhere; if left 0 a 2s default is used.
#   growth   — movement (Orbital) only: radial growth in world units/sec.
#              >0 makes the orbit spiral outward (SpiralOut); the projectile
#              despawns when the radius nears the arena edge. Ignored (0)
#              elsewhere. Optional column — older rows without it read 0.
#   damage_interval — onhit (Field) card: DoT tick interval in seconds. The
#              Field zone applies its damage to overlapping enemies once every
#              this many seconds (lower = faster ticks = higher sustained DPS).
#              0 here falls back to the legacy 0.5s Field tick. (In weapons.csv
#              this column drives ANY Sustained weapon's tick; 0 = single hit.)
#              Optional column — older rows without it read 0.
#   aim_mode  — movement (Homing / Aimed) only: which enemy the auto-targeting
#              Random. Ignored elsewhere. Optional column — older rows read 0.
